roads.name: US Highway 14A
words: Sweeping and steady: 71 curves in 19.2 miles.
The 3 miles at the north end are tamer.
About 1.1 miles in the middle are tamer.

Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 82°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 35 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.32 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
